notes: Standard tier (bytedance/seedance-2.0/image-to-video), billed per second of generated output at $0.3024/sec (10-sec clip ~$3.02). Fast tier available at $0.2419/sec (~$2.42 for 10 sec). Token-based billing also available: $0.014 per 1,000 tokens for 480p/720p/1080p and $0.008 per 1,000 tokens for 4k, where tokens = (height × width × duration × 24) / 1024. Only functional difference between Standard and Fast tiers is resolution support: Standard supports up to 1080p while Fast caps at 720p. Max reference images: start frame (image_url, required) plus optional end frame (end_image_url) = 2. Resolutions: 480p, 720p, 1080p (page text also mentions 1080p at $0.682/sec). Duration: auto or integer from 4 to 15 seconds, up to 15 seconds. Aspect ratios: auto, 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Native audio generation (music, SFX, lip-synced dialogue) included at no extra cost. Director-level camera control, realistic physics, multi-shot editing with natural cuts.
